text: Which plasma membrane proteins enhanced in lymphatic endothelial cells (single-cell) are expressed in every tissue?
plan: Subcellular location (ICC): Plasma membrane AND Cell type category (scRNA): Lymphatic endothelial cells / Cell type enhanced AND Tissue category (RNA): any / Detected in all
understanding: The user is querying for genes that localize to the plasma membrane, are enhanced in lymphatic endothelial cells based on single-cell RNA-seq data, and are expressed across all tissues (RNA distribution across tissues).

trail.why: Selecting 'Plasma membrane' at Level 1 restricts the results to proteins localized to the plasma membrane without imposing any reliability or annotation constraints at Level 2.
The requirement specifies expression enhanced in lymphatic endothelial cells based on single-cell data, which corresponds to Level 1 'Lymphatic endothelial cells' and Level 2 'Cell type enhanced'.
"Detected in all" is defined as being detected in every tissue of the dataset, and leaving level 1 unrestricted evaluates this across the dataset.

requirements.why: Selected 'Subcellular location (ICC)' because it specifically annotates experimental subcellular localization including 'Plasma membrane', unlike general predicted locations.
Selected 'Cell type category (scRNA)' because it evaluates RNA specificity categories (such as cell type enhanced) across single-cell types, specifically including 'Lymphatic endothelial cells'.
Selected 'Tissue category (RNA)' because it categorizes RNA distribution and specificity across all 36 tissues (e.g., expressed in all tissues).
